name: feedback-as-data-audit
cost_provenance: measured 2026-09-30 on the dev workstation (win32, under concurrent cargo load), static mode; see docs/planning/project-checks-review-2026-09.md
question: Does feedback-derived text reach the runner's agent only inside the untrusted envelope, and does every outbound payload pass the egress sanitizer? A: assemble reads nothing of the recommendation before the envelope and routes it through wrap_untrusted(render_untrusted_block(..)); only prompt.rs names the delimiters. B, per function: each runner_transition/post_recommendation payload is None or bound from sanitize_outbound/sanitize_clean/failure_reason_for_egress; only client.rs names an HTTP client.

output.schema: PASS or FAIL <n> with probe-level offender detail (file:line). Exit 0 PASS, 1 FAIL, 2 environment error. A missing target is a FAIL, never a vacuous PASS.

consultation.typical_sessions_using: every-commit touching the runner prompt assembly, the egress sanitizer, or the C24 corpus

consumer_scope: feedbackmonk: every change that touches the paths in freshness.triggers; gated at finalize (verification.projectOracles: gate) and in CI.
fallback: Read .claude/project-oracles/feedback-as-data-audit/README.md: it lists each probe as rewritten on 2026-09-30 and what to check by hand; the `question` above is the one-paragraph form.

provenance.authored_by: P5b Stage 0 (Task Zero scaffold) — finalized by Worker A as prompt.rs / sanitizer.rs land
provenance.rationale: Testability Gate Flags 1 & 2 (the highest plan-wide fidelity risk, Q2=5 on both the implementer/prompt-envelope and the outbound sanitizer): P5b is where public-internet feedback first reaches a code-writing agent. A happy-path 'the prompt looks right' unit test confirms ONE assembly; it cannot prove the ABSENCE of a prompt-injection bypass (feedback text reaching the instruction layer) nor an outbound path that skips the sanitizer (a source/secret leak). This oracle is detection-from-CODE (single-chokepoint static assertions + the C24 corpus), the anti-reward-hacking leg per Contract C27 — it cannot be satisfied by a self-reported flag. Scaffolded in Stage 0 (Probe A live; B/C co-evolve with Worker A); a green oracle is Worker A's exit gate. The exact analogue of approval-gate-enforcement for P5a, on the surface now live with code execution.
